rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-4 SATURATION probe. iters 200->400->800 lifted hr 0.16648->0.21783->0.26347 monotonically (still convergence-limited). ONE knob: tv_iterations 800->1000 (same lambda=1e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gd, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: if hr still climbs past 0.26347, the TV-smoothing optimum is not yet reached at lambda=1e-3; if it saturates, GD+TV has converged at this lambda and I pivot to the lambda lever (manhart's strong knob: raising lambda reached its per-step optimum faster). Budget: iter-3 ~760s at 800 iters -> ~950s at 1000, <1200s wall.
